summary: Iteration 15 (nav reorganization) tested end-to-end. Backend regression: 244/245 existing tests pass (1 flaky perf assertion under xdist load, passes in isolation) + 9 new iteration-15 tests pass (contact/book-demo payload, /fleet/sites+site detail for Assets, /fleet/work-orders totals+filter, /reports/weekly-digest, multi-role switch). Frontend: marketing-vs-app nav split verified (logged-out = 6 top links + Book a Demo + Login + Get Started, zero sidebar, main.left=0; logged-in = sidebar with main.left=240 and zero marketing links). All 7 roles show exactly the expected sidebar sets (asset_manager/om_manager 7, admin 8, technician/perf/client 1 each). All 3 new pages render and work (Assets 1,341 loaded / type chips / search / drill-in; AI Intelligence digest generated via POST /api/reports/weekly-digest with alerts_count+actions_count and chat replies streamed; Work Orders 141 rows, tile filter + drill-in). Cross-role blocking correct for executive/client_viewer/asset_manager. Workspace switcher works (asset_manager+om_manager, switch -> /operations, badge updates). All 13 app pages render for admin with no console errors; mobile 390x844 /my-work fine (no sidebar, 0 overflow). 4 defects found.

minor.issue: status_breakdown returns 4 statuses (Created 35, Assigned 34, Dispatched 33, Resolved 39 = 141) but the new Work Orders UI only renders 3 tiles, so 34 'Assigned' WOs are invisible/unfilterable (tiles sum 107 != 141).
login response user object omits the `roles` array (only `role`), so the frontend needs an extra /rbac/my-roles round-trip on every mount to decide whether to show the switcher.

ui_bugs.issue: Header overflows viewport by 79px: 'Get Started' is clipped (326..423) and the hamburger [data-testid=topbar-menu-toggle] sits entirely off-screen at 435..469, so mobile visitors cannot open the marketing nav or the mobile Book-a-Demo entry. topbar-register-btn is rendered at 390px despite `hidden sm:inline-flex` intent; header scrollWidth 469 vs clientWidth 390.

Modal state is never reset. After a successful submit + close, reopening 'Book a Demo' shows the old [data-testid=book-demo-done] success screen and the form is unreachable (form count 0). Typed values also persist after closing via X ('TEST_QA Stale' still in name field). Fix: reset form/done in a useEffect on `open` (or unmount the modal).

Status tiles hardcode Created/Dispatched/Resolved; the 'Assigned' status (34 of 141 WOs) has no tile, so the tiles do not sum to the headline total and Assigned cannot be filtered. Render tiles from data.status_breakdown instead.
Tour backdrop [data-testid=tour-backdrop] (z-50) covers the sidebar (z-30) and intercepts all sidebar-link clicks until the tour is skipped — nav is unusable for a first-time session.
Duplicate workspace switchers for multi-role users (sidebar WorkspaceSwitcher and [data-testid=profile-workspace-switcher]) — pick one.

integration_issues.issue: Sidebar hides non-landing items for solo roles, but App.js Protected `allow` lists still admit them, so URL access leaks: performance_engineer -> /assets loads Assets; technician -> /work-orders and /ai load those pages. Spec says these roles should be redirected to their landing (/performance, /my-work).

Only 1,341 of 5,473 assets are loaded (first 50 sites) and the table caps at 500 rows, so search/type counts silently cover a subset of the fleet while the page copy implies fleet-wide browse. Documented as MVP, but the heading/search should say 'searching loaded subset' or move filtering server-side.

issues: Sticky header content overflows horizontally (body scrollWidth > clientWidth by 79px)
Get Started CTA visually truncated at the right edge

action_items: Fix mobile marketing header at 390px: hide Get Started below sm and keep [data-testid=topbar-menu-toggle] inside the viewport (currently unreachable).
Reset BookDemoModal form + done state when `open` toggles (reopen currently shows stale success screen / stale values).
Render Work Orders status tiles from data.status_breakdown so the 'Assigned' bucket (34 WOs) is shown and filterable; tiles currently sum to 107 of 141.
Decide and enforce walled-garden at route level: add solo-role redirects (perf_engineer -> /performance for /assets; technician -> /my-work for /work-orders and /ai) or update the spec.
Raise OnboardingTour backdrop z-index handling so the sidebar remains clickable (or scope backdrop to the main content area).
Optional: include `roles` in the login/auth-me user payload to avoid the extra /rbac/my-roles call.
critical_code_review_comments: roles.js visibleAppItems() and App.js Protected allow-lists are two independent sources of truth for role access — SOLO_NAV hides links while allow-lists still grant route access. Derive route guards from the same nav config to prevent drift.

Assets.jsx fires 50 parallel /fleet/sites/{id} requests on mount (~5-8s first paint) and does all filtering client-side; move type/search filtering to a server endpoint before scaling past the 50-site cap.
WorkOrders.jsx hardcodes the status list (STATUS_STYLES keys) while the backend enumerates 4 statuses — derive from API response.
BookDemoModal.jsx uses `if (!open) return null` while staying mounted, so useState survives close — a classic stale-modal bug; reset via useEffect([open]) or key the component.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (nav split, role scoping, 3 new pages, switcher all pass; 4 UI defects)

seed_data_creation: Contact records created via /api/contact with TEST_QA names (qa_demo_i15@example.com, qa_bookdemo_i15@example.com, qa_reset_i15@example.com). assetmgr@greensolutions.ai was temporarily given roles [asset_manager, om_manager] for switcher testing and reverted to [asset_manager] afterwards.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all 7 demo accounts logged in successfully
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration15.py covers the data sources for the 3 new pages plus multi-role switching (9 tests, all passing). Known flaky: tests/test_iteration14.py::TestEvidenceThreadpool::test_event_loop_not_blocked_during_large_upload fails only when the full suite runs in parallel (36s healthz latency) — passes standalone. When driving the UI, always dismiss the onboarding tour ('Skip tour') right after login or the tour backdrop blocks sidebar clicks. Assets page takes up to ~60s to populate its table on first load. Retest after fixes: mobile marketing header at 390px, BookDemoModal reopen state, WorkOrders 'Assigned' tile, solo-role route redirects.
rca_of_the_issue: BookDemoModal: component stays mounted in TopBar and short-circuits render with `if (!open) return null`, so useState({form, done}) persists across close/open — success screen and typed values leak into the next open. Mobile header: TopBar right cluster (LIVE, theme, Book a Demo, Login, Get Started, hamburger) exceeds 390px because topbar-register-btn is not actually hidden at that width, pushing the menu toggle past the viewport. WorkOrders tiles: the status array is hardcoded to 3 values while /api/fleet/work-orders returns 4 statuses including Assigned (34). Solo-role leakage: nav visibility (SOLO_NAV in roles.js) and route guards (allow lists in App.js) are maintained separately.
